_about: Shared conformance cases for the Cellucid data mapping. The same file is kept byte-for-byte in cellucid-python (tests/fixtures/data_mapping_conformance.json), cellucid-r (tests/testthat/fixtures/data_mapping_conformance.json) and the web app (tests/fixtures/data-mapping-conformance.json); each repository pins its SHA-256. Every 'expected' value is the canonical output of the reference rule; an 'error' value is the stable reason code, not a message.

a non-string name is an error
